Co-optex.full_name: Tamil Nadu Handloom Weavers' Co-operative Society
Co-optex.about: Weavers' cooperative of Tamil Nadu, selling handloom silk and cotton sarees, dhotis and home linen.

Hanveev.full_name: Kerala State Handloom Development Corporation Ltd
Hanveev.about: Government of Kerala corporation selling Kerala handloom, including kasavu sarees and mundu.

Jharcraft.full_name: Jharkhand Silk Textile & Handicraft Development Corporation Ltd
Jharcraft.about: Government of Jharkhand corporation selling tussar silk and crafts from Jharkhand.

Garvi Gurjari.full_name: Gujarat State Handloom & Handicraft Development Corporation
Garvi Gurjari.about: Government of Gujarat emporium for Gujarat handloom and handicrafts, such as Patola and Kutch weaves.

Boyanika.full_name: Odisha State Handloom Weavers' Cooperative Society Ltd
Boyanika.about: Weavers' cooperative of Odisha, known for Sambalpuri ikat and Odisha silks.

Tantuja.full_name: The West Bengal State Handloom Weavers' Co-operative Society Ltd
Tantuja.about: Weavers' cooperative of West Bengal, selling tant, Baluchari and other Bengal sarees.

Biswa Bangla.about: Government of West Bengal stores for Bengal handloom, handicrafts and food products.

Mrignayani.about: Government of Madhya Pradesh emporium for Chanderi and Maheshwari weaves and crafts.

Bhuttico.full_name: Bhutti Weavers Handloom and Handicraft Co-operative Society Ltd
Bhuttico.about: Weavers' cooperative in Kullu Valley, founded in 1944, known for Kullu shawls and Himachali caps.

Priyadarshini Handlooms.about: Government of Karnataka corporation selling Karnataka handloom, including Ilkal and Molakalmuru sarees.

UPICA.about: Industrial cooperative of Uttar Pradesh, registered in 1952, selling handloom made in the state.

MahaHandloom.full_name: The Maharashtra State Handlooms Corporation Ltd
MahaHandloom.about: Government of Maharashtra corporation based in Nagpur, known for Paithani sarees and wild silks.

APCO.full_name: Andhra Pradesh State Handloom Weavers' Co-operative Society
APCO.about: Weavers' cooperative of Andhra Pradesh, selling Mangalagiri, Venkatagiri and other Andhra handloom.
